name: 47356 · Middletown, IN
findings: ZIP 47356 (Middletown) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47356 (Middletown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
